status: Keeper House, town officers, Keeper1 phone, cracked handset.
_about: Ours, not a design copy. Hearthmoor stays the Keepers' town. Glimmerwell buildings read mint. The phone is a side quest on Route 1.

replaceObjs.text: HEARTHMOOR · Hill village of keepers. East: Route 1.

addObjs.text: KEEPER HOUSE · Hearthmoor watch. The lantern's law.

lines.story.side=glimmer: Mint vest. Not welcome on this road.
lines.standing.keepers>=3: Name's on the good list. Walk easy.
lines.standing.keepers>=1: A keeper on the road. Glad you are out.
lines.story.side=keepers: New pledge. The lantern still knows you.
lines.else: Citizen. Say your piece, then step back.

lines.story.side=glimmer: Mint on the east path. Keep walking.
lines.standing.keepers>=3: East gate is yours. Walk easy.
lines.standing.keepers>=1: A keeper at the gate. Good.
lines.story.side=keepers: New pledge. The gate stays open.
lines.else: Citizen. East is Route 1. Stay kind.

lines.story.side=glimmer: The House is ours. Look. Do not sit.
lines.standing.keepers>=3: Captain Lumen asked after you today.
lines.standing.keepers>=1: Door's open for a keeper. Come through.
lines.story.side=keepers: New to the coat? Bram will sign you in.
lines.else: Citizen. The House is for the watch.

lines.story.side=glimmer: That handset still sits on our wires.
lines.else: Keeper1 is yours. The wires stay ours.

lines.story.side=glimmer: Mint in the orchard. I am not smiling.
lines.standing.keepers>=3: Fernbrook is glad of you. Truly.
lines.standing.keepers>=1: A keeper in the square. Welcome.
lines.story.side=keepers: New pledge. The trees still count you.

lines.story.side=glimmer: Census tents. I do not like the lamps.
lines.standing.keepers>=1: The watch walked this far with you.
lines.else: Citizen. Stay on the path if you can.

lines.story.side=glimmer: You like these lamps. I am writing that.
lines.else: Not the lantern. I am watching.

lines.story.side=glimmer: You sold the seam. I remember the vote.
lines.else: Citizen. The quarry road is watched.

lines.story.side=glimmer: Colleague. The seam is ours. Smile.

objs.text: STAIRS · Captain Lumen and the radio, upstairs.

lines.story.side=glimmer: Doorway only. You do not sit here.
lines.standing.keepers>=3: Your name is on the good list. Come in.
lines.standing.keepers>=1: A keeper on the step. You may come in.
lines.story.side=keepers: New pledge. The lantern still knows you.
lines.else: Citizen. Say your piece, then step back.

lines.story.side=glimmer: I note the mint. The books will too.
lines.standing.keepers>=1: The shelf is open to a keeper. Read.
lines.else: Citizen. Old books stay on the shelf.

lines.story.side=glimmer: Your notes still copy to my book.
lines.standing.keepers>=1: I filed you under friend of the house.
lines.else: Citizen. Forms are on the left. Wait.

objs.text: RADIO · Every Keeper1 checks in. Even the quiet ones.

lines.story.side=glimmer: You are in my office. Make it short.
lines.standing.keepers>=3: I kept a chair for you. Sit, friend.
lines.standing.keepers>=1: The watch is glad of your name.
lines.story.side=keepers: New pledge. Do the small jobs first.
lines.else: Citizen. Hats off. Then you may speak.

lines.story.side=glimmer: I can hear the room around your set.
lines.standing.keepers>=1: Your Keeper1 sings a clean signal.
lines.else: Citizen. If the handset is on, so am I.

phone_grant: Two green coats step out of the grass and stop you on the path.
Citizen. The wild starts here. So does the service.
Every person under the lantern gets a Keeper1. It is free.
Calls, notes, friends. The handset is yours to hold.
The poles, the wires, the companies: those stay with us.
A watched path is a safe path. Have a lawful day.
hq_bram: You can stand in the doorway. You do not sit.
The lantern keeps this house. Your company does not.
If you need a form, ask. If you need a friend, look elsewhere.
Mo writes the mint down. Wynn copies your notes. You do not get a chair.
Your company likes a bright day. This doorway is as far as you come.
Sergeant Bram. I run the door, and Bren walks the road.
Before you pledge, you are a citizen. The watch eats first.
Pledge, and do the work, and the chairs get warmer.
Mo has the shelf. Wynn has the book. Lumen and Rue keep the upstairs.
hq_mo: I will write down the mint. I write down everything.
Your machine has been leaking a long, long time.
They smile and will not name it. The books leave that space blank.
The books fear a child born already listening. No date is written.
I keep the old books. Some of them are not comfortable.
The Arbiter, over in their house, has been emitting for ages.
People who stay near it change. A little more metal, each birth.
The books fear a child born already listening. We have not seen one.
We do not hurt Walklings. We do not cheer that fear. We record it.
The emission has no name. The oldest page leaves that space empty.
If you ever wear their crest, look at your own hands.
hq_wynn: I copy every Keeper1 note into the book. That is the law, said plainly.
Their thin handset still sits on our wires. Cracked is not hidden.
The handset is free. The poles and the wires stay with this house.
They say have a bright day. The copy in my book does not.
Bram keeps the door. I keep the copies. The captain keeps the rank.
hq_lumen: You are in my office. Say the short version.
KeeperUAV is our board. You will not be taking jobs from it.
Your posters say brighter by nature. My office says you may leave.
Captain Lumen. The watch is mine. The town is the lantern's.
A citizen waits in the doorway. A keeper is offered a chair.
A mint vest is asked to leave. Rank is not a secret here.
KeeperUAV will list jobs when the desk is ready. The board is blank.
Rue holds the radio. Every Keeper1 on our wires checks in with her.
Mo records a slow change. I keep my watch clear of their machine.
hq_rue: If a handset is on, I can hear the room around it.
We own the poles from this hill to the coast. There is no other net.
Smile for your company if you like. I already hear your room.
The Keeper1 is free. The law stops at the handset. The wire is ours.
Wynn copies the notes. I hear the quiet rooms. Lumen says who sits here.

flags.story.phone_got: Route 1 side quest. The Keeper1 handset is issued. Not a main-chain step.
flags.story.met_bram: Sergeant Bram's first talk in the Keeper House.
